answer: Meadow-plot admission auction: 100 meadow plots go to sealed-bid auction each epoch on a crystal ledger. An agent locks 70 credits and seals its bid with a key-bound umber stamp; top 100 win, losers refunded. A sybil farmer wanting 1,000 plots must win 1,000 bids: first 45, kth 45+8(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 4,041,000 plus 70,000 locked, for 40,000 rewards. Rented bids fail: a second key on one umber stamp voids both. Honest agents pay 45 once.
